description_en: Clones a cloud computer policy to quickly create a custom cloud computer policy
description_zh: 通过克隆云电脑策略来实现快速创建自定义云电脑策略的目的
kebab_example: aliyun ecd clone-policy-group --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --policy-group-id pg-gx2x1dhsmthe90000 --name testPolicyGroupName --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ClonePolicyGroup

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call [DescribeRegions](~~DescribeRegions~~) to query the regions supported by Elastic Desktop Service
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~DescribeRegions~~)获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the cloud computer policy that you want to clone
parameters.help_zh: 需要克隆的目标云电脑策略ID
parameters.name: policy_group_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the new cloud computer policy
parameters.help_zh: 新的云电脑策略的名称
parameters.name: name
